posts.text: Why Traders Under Financial Pressure Struggle to Master Trading Psychology — Completely agree with the points shared here. When traders are under financial pressure, intraday and F&O volatility often triggers emotional decisions and revenge trading. One thing that personally helped me reduce screen stress was shifting a portion of my capital away from daily F&O trades toward primary market opportunities (Mainboard and SME IPOs) and swing setups.
